**Replace one terrain with another over the whole map**

Edit ▸ Replace terrain… paints every column of one terrain with another, over the whole map, or only in the selection when there is one, in one step to undo. Pick both terrains from lists sorted by category, with a search. It is the way to merge duplicates, such as a terrain a WorldPainter world brought as Imported and the same block read from a mod. Asked for by Jack (Fornad).
